related.title: OpenZFS：重建完成與 checksum 覆蓋的不同證據
related.titleEn: OpenZFS: reconstruction completion versus checksum coverage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付區塊副本矩陣、digest 核對、修復前後報告與過期備份反例；所有資料均為新建教學檔；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the copy matrix, digest checks, before-and-after reports and a stale-backup counterexample. All bytes are newly created teaching fixtures, with no access to the learner’s real storage pool. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 分開 copied_ranges、verified_ranges 與 failed_ranges，將半開區間做聯集；進度報表不可使用單一 completed 欄位。
related.differenceEn: Keep copied, verified and failed ranges separately and union half-open intervals. Avoid one ambiguous completed field; the report must state which operation completed for which part of the target.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學雙副本模型中，至少有一份通過預期 checksum 的區塊才可恢復；可恢復比例為合格區塊數除總數；一百個邏輯區塊，其中三個只有一份壞、兩個兩份皆壞，其餘正常；變更用已驗證備份修復那兩個區塊；名義式 (100-2)/100*100 = 98 % recoverable blocks；變更式 100/100*100 = 100 % recoverable blocks。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

驗證覆蓋率是已完成 checksum 檢查的獨特位元組除本次目標範圍；重複掃描同一範圍不能增加覆蓋；目標 100 GiB 且已全部重建；名義 checksum 覆蓋 40 GiB，變更 100 GiB；不存在未解決的 checksum 錯誤；名義式 40/100*100 = 40 % verified coverage；變更式 100/100*100 = 100 % verified coverage。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: In the two-copy fixture, a block is recoverable only if at least one copy matches its expected checksum. Recoverable fraction divides qualifying logical blocks by total blocks, not good replicas by replica count. Use one hundred logical blocks: three have one bad copy, two have both copies bad and the rest are healthy. Restore the two unrecoverable blocks from a separately verified backup in the changed fixture. Nominal (100-2)/100*100 = 98 % recoverable blocks; changed 100/100*100 = 100 % recoverable blocks. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Verification coverage is unique target bytes whose checksum checks completed divided by the target range. Repeated scans of the same range do not increase coverage, even if total I/O counters grow. The target is 100 GiB and reconstruction is complete in both cases. Checksum coverage changes from 40 to 100 GiB, with no unresolved checksum failures in the covered portions. Nominal 40/100*100 = 40 % verified coverage; changed 100/100*100 = 100 % verified coverage. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: UPS：可用能量、轉換損失與支援時間
related.titleEn: UPS: usable energy, conversion losses and support duration
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付區塊副本矩陣、digest 核對、修復前後報告與過期備份反例；所有資料均為新建教學檔；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the copy matrix, digest checks, before-and-after reports and a stale-backup counterexample. All bytes are newly created teaching fixtures, with no access to the learner’s real storage pool. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立 energy_kWh、usable_fraction、efficiency、load_kW 與 power_limit；先驗證負載不超功率能力，再做能量除法。
related.differenceEn: Record energy, usable fraction, efficiency, load and power limit. Check the instantaneous power condition before calculating duration; enough energy cannot compensate for an output stage unable to supply the load.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學雙副本模型中，至少有一份通過預期 checksum 的區塊才可恢復；可恢復比例為合格區塊數除總數；一百個邏輯區塊，其中三個只有一份壞、兩個兩份皆壞，其餘正常；變更用已驗證備份修復那兩個區塊；名義式 (100-2)/100*100 = 98 % recoverable blocks；變更式 100/100*100 = 100 % recoverable blocks。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

恆功率模型時間為名義能量*可用比例*效率/負載，單位小時後乘六十；不含放電倍率曲線與老化的額外效應；名義能量 20 kWh、可用比例 0.8、轉換效率 0.9；負載由 100 改為 120 kW；名義式 20*0.8*0.9/100*60 = 8.64 min modeled runtime；變更式 20*0.8*0.9/120*60 = 7.2 min modeled runtime。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: In the two-copy fixture, a block is recoverable only if at least one copy matches its expected checksum. Recoverable fraction divides qualifying logical blocks by total blocks, not good replicas by replica count. Use one hundred logical blocks: three have one bad copy, two have both copies bad and the rest are healthy. Restore the two unrecoverable blocks from a separately verified backup in the changed fixture. Nominal (100-2)/100*100 = 98 % recoverable blocks; changed 100/100*100 = 100 % recoverable blocks. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

In a constant-power model, duration equals nominal energy times usable fraction times efficiency divided by load, then converted from hours to minutes. Discharge-rate curves and additional aging effects are excluded. Nominal energy is 20 kWh, usable fraction 0.8 and conversion efficiency 0.9. Constant load changes from 100 to 120 kW. The values are synthetic and are not a vendor battery-runtime curve. Nominal 20*0.8*0.9/100*60 = 8.64 min modeled runtime; changed 20*0.8*0.9/120*60 = 7.2 min modeled runtime. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
